name: openrouter-credits
title: OpenRouter Credits
description: Show your OpenRouter credit balance in the menu bar and get low-balance alerts.
author: cyprusad

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Management API Key
preferences.description: Create a key with the Get Management API Key menu action, then paste it here. A regular inference API key cannot read credit data.

preferences.name: lowBalanceNotifications
preferences.title: Low-Balance Alerts
preferences.description: Show a Raycast notification when your balance reaches the alert amount.
preferences.label: Notify me about a low balance

preferences.name: lowBalanceThreshold
preferences.title: Low-Balance Alert Amount
preferences.description: Send an alert when the remaining balance is at or below this USD amount.
